items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: And the clarinet player was named Winnie Smollett.

ctx.x: Paul. And his son's name was Paul too?
The young one, the drummer was named Paul. The young one was Paul. The drum was named Paul. And the clarinet player was named Winnie Smollett.
That's the same guy they called Kid Ernest.
